info.syllabusName: Fundamental of Graphic design_Nguyên lý đồ hoạ cơ bản
info.description:
Description: This course provides an introduction to visual design for students and provides them with the basic knowledge of design, visual principles, and visual form of a composition of art. Students will be able to lay out the composition of art works, analyze, and evaluate the effect of design elements in each composition on human eyes.
Through this course, students will gain the knowledge and skills necessary to develop concepts, manipulate materials, and apply art elements and design principles to create effective and appropriate visual works based on the learned knowledge and skills.
info.studentTasks:
1. Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
2. Actively participate in class activities
3. Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
5. Read the textbook in advance
6. Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/gui/Home) for up-to-date information and material of the course.
info.tools:

- Paper (size A3, A4). Sketching paper sheet (A3)
- Color, pencil, eraser, brushes, back ink pen, art lines, markers
- Paper knife, roll of paper tape,
- Laptop
- Digital graphic design tools
- Drawing board.

clos.loDetails: Describe basic design and visual principles.
Explain how people communicate visually and how visual principles affect human eyes.
Apply the art elements and knowledge of design principles to construct basic visual art compositions of graphic design, with appropriate use of AI tools as supportive aids,
Analyze constructure in an art composition.
Create the learner's own work of art based on learned knowledge and skills, including using handicraft.
Demonstrate a positive attitude, a professional working style, and ethical awareness in the use of AI tools in design practice.

assessments.questionType:
- Students to collect specific natural elements to sketch a basic composition of natural objects.
- Students sketch natural elements, and analyze the organic and geometric feature of the sketch.
- Drawing a black and white piece of visual idea/concept to create a stylized image of the nature elements
assessments.knowledgeSkill:
Knowledge
- Understanding of basic design and visual principles
- Knowledge of how to analyze construction in art composition
- Awareness of ethical considerations in using AI tools for reference, inspiration, or stylization.
Skills
- Observation & research skills natural elements closely.
- Sketching and translating observed forms into basic compositions.
- Simplifying natural forms into points, lines, and geometric or organic shapes.
assessments.gradingGuide:
1. Students follow instructor's guide and observe nature
2. Students collect/take a photographs of the natural elements, and sketch.
3. Defining and stylizing points, lines and geometric shapes from a natural elements to composition following instructor's guide.
4. Peer and instructor's review in class
5. Submit work in class
assessments.note:
Submission Files:
1. Word file containing all research and development steps including AI Usage Report (.docx/PDF)
2. Sketches in class (paper)
3. Submit the final work in class
In-Class Work:
1. Presentation of research and sketches
2. Peer and instructor feedback on sketch, research, and stylizing idea.
3. Drafting and revising assignment during In-class sessions.
4. Submit the final work in class

assessments.questionType:
- Research the rhythm from everyday life.
- Create black and white module using lines and geometric and organic shapes collected from assignment 1
- Make compositions with rhythm from modular.
assessments.knowledgeSkill:
Knowledge
- Understanding of rhythm as a principle of design
- Knowledge of how art elements (line, shape, form, space) can be organized into rhythmic structures.
- Knowledge of modular composition techniques in graphic design.
Skills
- Create a repeatable visual unit from simple elements.
- Arranging modules to form balanced, dynamic rhythmic designs.
- Analyze how rhythm affects visual impact and viewer experience.
assessments.gradingGuide:
1. Students pick a part of geometric and organic shapes collected from assignment 1.
2. Using digital tools, rotate, locate and modify the chosen motif to create patterns with rhythm.
3. Peer and instructor's review in class
4. Submit work in class
assessments.note:
Submission Files:
1. Submit the final work in class (PDF)
In-Class Work:
1. Peer and instructor feedback on sketch, motif and rhythm idea.
2. Drafting and revising assignment during In-class sessions.
3. Submit the final work in class

assessments.questionType:
